name: Equipment Sales Co Inc.
old_description: Founded in 1989, Equipment Sales Co Inc. represents the automotive service equipment manufacturers to entire Pacific Northwest Region. We offer sales, service, and installation of automotive service equipment, in addition to design, installation, training, and inspection services.
about:
Equipment Sales Co Inc. is based in Snohomish, Washington, and was incorporated in 1989 by Scott Wilson to represent manufacturers of motor vehicle service equipment across the Pacific Northwest. In 1994, Kirby McFarland acquired the company and expanded its scope to include service work on the product lines it represented; by 1999 the firm had become a full distributor and contractor specializing in motor vehicle service equipment.

The company distributes, installs, and services a range of automotive shop equipment, including vehicle lifts with capacities from 5,500 to 120,000 pounds, lubrication dispensing and inventory systems, compressed air systems, vehicle exhaust removal systems, inventory storage systems, and wheel service equipment. It represents brands such as Rotary Lift, Graco, Shure Manufacturing, Weaver Lift, RTI, LeRoi, Hoover Group, and Champion, and also provides design services for shop layouts, operator training, safety inspections, and ALI‑certified lift inspections performed by three certified inspectors on staff.

Its customers include car and truck dealerships, independent repair shops, municipal garages, and military maintenance facilities throughout the Pacific Northwest, ranging from single‑bay operations to large multi‑bay facilities.

The business was founded to bring specialized motor vehicle service equipment to the region and has differentiated itself by maintaining factory‑trained technicians, offering turnkey installation and project management, and holding Automotive Lift Institute certification for lift inspections.
